description: This file defines the MultiException class, which is a custom exception designed to handle multiple root causes, typically used in scenarios where multiple operations are performed and some may fail, but execution continues until all are processed. It manages a list of Throwable causes, provides custom message formatting, and different ways to print stack traces.

classes.name: MultiException
classes.description: A custom exception class that encapsulates multiple Throwable causes, allowing aggregated error reporting and stack trace printing.

methods.name: MultiException
methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with a message and a list of problems (throwables). Ensures the list is not empty.

methods.name: MultiException
methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with a list of problems (throwables), generating a default message.

methods.name: getCauses
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable list of the cause throwables.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Overrides the default to include detailed messages and stack traces of all causes.

methods.name: printStackTrace
methods.description: Overrides default to log the error message and print the stack traces of all causes.

methods.name: printStackTrace(PrintStream)
methods.description: Prints the exception message and causes' stack traces to the provided PrintStream.

methods.name: printStackTrace(PrintWriter)
methods.description: Prints the exception message and causes' stack traces to the provided PrintWriter.
